notes: CTRY-CA: sources accessed 2026-11-01 UTC. Official means the specific statement was read in a primary source, not legal approval or entity verification. Indexed-only evidence is identified in each source note; unresolved interpretations remain pending or candidate.

English is enabled now and formats derive as en-CA. French (fr, formatted fr-CA) awaits LANG-FR. A Quebec hub must configure French as its default once its French dictionaries are installed; v2 has no subdivision defaultLocale field. The language-law fact is data, not an automatic locale switch.

There are six conventional time-zone families, including Newfoundland half-hour time. IANA zones also capture local exceptions and history; current rules and offsets come from runtime tzdata, not a hard-coded six-offset table. Region zone lists follow IANA geographic comments.

All identifier examples are format examples only, not real company records. Additional provincial/territorial corporate number formats, contractor licence classes and local permits remain unverified; the Ontario registry and Quebec examples do not stand for all provinces.
